title: Cyber Verification Program Security Requirements | Claude Help Center
summary: Individual Defense Access requires identity-provider login with MFA and personal, unshared access.
The December 15, 2026 cutoff requires phishing-resistant MFA and the transition away from static model credentials; platform-specific rules apply.
Individual grant traffic is retained and monitored, without a zero-retention option.
Incident reporting, cooperation, and ongoing-review duties apply. Consult the current official text for exact deadlines and exceptions.
